full_description: Experimental pair: pick up the bottle, then either hold it steady above the blue pad or place it on the blue pad and release it.
schema: {I} is the entire fixed instruction selected by the episode mode. Both instructions start with 'Pick up the bottle and' and refer to 'the blue pad'. Keep the instruction unchanged: hold requires steady suspended grasping above the pad; place requires placement on the pad followed by release. Do not add an arm, an upright orientation, or a shaking instruction. The seen/unseen keys are interface-compatible aliases for the same fixed pair, not separate language pools.
